title: Find a computer by its BitLocker recovery password
description: Search AD for the computer that matches a given BitLocker recovery password (useful when a user has the password but not the PC name).

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Get-ADObject
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: $searchPassword = '{recoveryPassword}'; Get-ADObject -Filter "objectClass -eq 'msFVE-RecoveryInformation'" -Properties msFVE-RecoveryPassword | Where-Object {$_.'msFVE-RecoveryPassword' -like "*$searchPassword*"} | ForEach-Object { $computerDN = ($_.DistinguishedName -split ',',2)[1]; $computer = Get-ADComputer -Identity $computerDN; [PSCustomObject]@{ Computer=$computer.Name; RecoveryPassword=$_.'msFVE-RecoveryPassword'; ComputerDN=$computer.DistinguishedName } }

parameters.name: recoveryPassword
parameters.label: Recovery password
parameters.description: Password or start of the password (first digits)

examples.description: Find the computer that matches the first digits of the password

examples.command: $fullPassword = '123456-789012-345678-901234-567890-123456-789012-890123'; Get-ADObject -Filter "objectClass -eq 'msFVE-RecoveryInformation'" -Properties msFVE-RecoveryPassword | Where-Object {$_.'msFVE-RecoveryPassword' -eq $fullPassword} | ForEach-Object { $computerDN = ($_.DistinguishedName -split ',',2)[1]; Get-ADComputer -Identity $computerDN | Select-Object Name,DNSHostName }
examples.description: Find the computer with the exact full password
Find the computer by recovery key GUID
Show the results in a table sized for the console. Format-Table -AutoSize adjusts the column widths for readable output. Good for a quick look at structured data.
Export the results to a CSV file that Excel can open. -NoTypeInformation drops the metadata line. -Encoding UTF8 keeps accented characters intact. Useful for archiving, reports and external analysis.
Count the objects returned. Measure-Object returns Count, Sum, Average, Min and Max depending on the properties. Useful for quick statistics and to validate results.

notes: USE CASE: a user is stuck on the BitLocker recovery screen and gives the first digits of the password; the administrator looks for the matching PC. PARTIAL SEARCH: use the first groups of digits (e.g. 123456-789012). FULL SEARCH: use the whole password for an exact match. Very useful for the helpdesk!

fr.title: Trouver un ordinateur par son mot de passe de récupération BitLocker
fr.description: Recherche dans AD quel ordinateur correspond à un mot de passe de récupération BitLocker donné (utile quand un utilisateur a le mot de passe mais pas le nom du PC).
fr.notes: CAS D'USAGE: Utilisateur bloqué avec écran de récupération BitLocker, fournit les premiers chiffres du mot de passe, admin cherche à quel PC cela correspond. RECHERCHE PARTIELLE: Utilisez les premiers groupes de chiffres (ex: 123456-789012). RECHERCHE COMPLÈTE: Utilisez le mot de passe entier pour match exact. Très utile pour helpdesk!

recoveryPassword.label: Mot de passe de récupération
recoveryPassword.description: Mot de passe ou début du mot de passe (premiers chiffres)
